_comment: Tool catalog used by the mock self-test. Names and parameter shapes mirror the tools DSH actually registers (dsh-tool-fs, dsh-tool-fs-search), so the scripted tool calls exercise the same wire shape the app will send.

function.name: write
function.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

function.name: read
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return.

function.name: glob
function.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search.
